Human system: Lattice · experimental workspace recovery. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Partial Weave assembles available functions when complete configurations are absent; its incomplete checks permit volatile combinations.
The proposed local history includes unstable reconstruction and eventual loss of community continuity. Custodian intervention and internal faults remain competing or combined causes.
The end of the community does not demonstrate that every attempted combination was a person or that none was.
